manifest_encoding: UTF-8 compact serde_json::to_vec(PublicIdCensusV2Manifest) in declared Rust field order, no BOM or trailing newline; reject other bytes
manifest_digest: SHA-256 of the same typed compact serialization after replacing manifest_sha256 with the empty string
null_ledger_encoding: UTF-8 compact serde_json::to_vec(PublicIdCensusV2NullLedger) in declared Rust field order, no BOM or trailing newline; records sorted by ascending numeric repository_id
null_ledger_reconciliation: probe_only_null_count plus crawled_null_count equals ledger length; crawled_null_count equals records with crawled true; exact records rederived from raw exchanges
frame_reconciliation: resolved_in_window_count minus resolved_ineligible_count equals the sum of six frame repository counts; all six exact frame bytes rederived from raw exchanges
source_commitment: policy and artifact-contract preflight receipts, sequential raw exchanges, null ledger, six frames, and manifest counts are SHA-256 bound and replay-validated; no partial manifest
live_precondition: Before the first live v2 REST request, fetch this contract and the v2 source policy by immutable public Git commit and verify their exact bytes and pinned SHA-256 values. Offline fixtures do not satisfy this live precondition.
